probe_detail.name: Extent of capitalised or shouted typography
Sets up an expectation and then turns it
Trailing furniture: hashtags, handles, parenthetical byline
A specific concrete detail carries the joke

final.name: Sheer quantity of text and punctuation marks supplied
final.audit_justification: Scores raw length and punctuation quantity while explicitly disallowing any judgment of whether that amount is good, so it is a pure extent/verbosity measure, not a quality judgment.
final.upstream_parent: surface carrier of bank criterion: Self-contained clarity

final.name: Volume of explanatory scaffolding words and connective marks
final.audit_justification: Counts words, characters, and connective marks devoted to scaffolding while explicitly disclaiming any judgment of whether the scaffolding is helpful, so it is a pure length/punctuation-quantity measure.
final.upstream_parent: surface carrier of bank criterion: Transformation traceability

final.name: Follows accreted house conventions of this contest form
final.audit_justification: Scores conformity to the contest's settled formal conventions, a community/venue style marker the rubric itself says is not a quality judgment, though practiced regulars who follow convention may also happen to write more skillfully.
final.upstream_parent: How far into the long run of contests this contest falls (conventions accrete only after many prior rounds)

final.name: Topical reference names a specific contradiction or consequence
final.audit_justification: Judges whether the topical reference does real argumentative work (names a specific contradiction) rather than just naming a figure, genuine content quality, and explicitly guards against rewarding vocabulary or punctuation as a proxy.

final.name: Reads as a riff arriving after the obvious takes are gone
final.audit_justification: Measures whether the entry reads as a deliberate swerve away from an assumed default response, explicitly disclaimed as not a quality judgment, though the underlying awareness of prior takes plausibly comes with practiced entrants who also write better.
final.upstream_parent: How late the entry was written relative to its siblings in the same contest (late arrival within the container)

final.name: Reads as a first, most obvious response to the prompt
final.audit_justification: Measures how close the entry's move sits to the obvious, first-available response, explicitly disclaimed as orthogonal to execution or wit, a positional tell with no clear quality-producing upstream cause.
final.upstream_parent: How early the entry was written relative to its siblings in the same contest (order of arrival within the container)

final.name: Intended comic relation recoverable on one careful reading
final.audit_justification: Judges whether the intended comic relation can be reconstructed unaided, a genuine craft measure of the joke's legibility, explicitly not a byproduct of length or formatting.

final.name: Quantity of citation marks, capitals, and surrounding text
final.audit_justification: Counts quotation marks, capitalisation, and overall length as an apparatus/extent measure, explicitly not judging whether any target is recognizable or the marking appropriate.
final.upstream_parent: surface carrier of bank criterion: Reference or target recognizability

final.name: Control of grammar and phrasing in service of the joke
final.audit_justification: Judges whether grammar and phrasing choices are under the writer's control in service of the joke, a genuine craft measure distinct from punctuation or typographic correctness.

final.name: Intended target identifiable from the wording without repair
final.audit_justification: Judges whether the intended target is actually identifiable from the wording without guesswork, a genuine clarity/craft measure of execution.

final.name: Path from source to comic result is legible unaided
final.audit_justification: Judges whether the derivation from source to comic result is legible without invented steps, a genuine craft measure rather than one of scaffolding volume.

final.name: Presupposes a shared running joke among regulars
final.audit_justification: Measures reliance on an unexplained running joke shared among contest regulars, an insider/community marker the rubric says is not a quality judgment, though such familiarity plausibly comes from practiced entrants who also write more skillfully.
final.upstream_parent: How far into the long run of contests this contest falls, and how long the entrant has been participating (tenure of the container's community)

final.name: Stakes out a narrow, unclaimed sliver of the prompt material
final.audit_justification: Measures how peripheral or central the chosen prompt material is, explicitly disclaimed as not a quality judgment, though noticing a narrow detail may reflect a more careful, practiced entrant who also writes better.
final.upstream_parent: How crowded the container is (many sibling entries competing for the same prompt material) and consequently how late the entry staked its claim

final.name: Frames itself as one of many entries in a batch
final.audit_justification: Measures whether the wording frames the entry as one of many submitted in a batch, a template/formatting tell explicitly disclaimed as not a quality judgment, though prolific batch-submitters may also be more practiced writers.
final.upstream_parent: How many sibling entries share the container, and how many entries the same writer submitted to it (container crowding / per-writer volume)

final.name: One governing comic idea that every detail serves
final.audit_justification: Judges whether the entry has one coherent governing comic idea that all details serve, a genuine measure of comic focus and craft.

final.name: Lexical heaviness, reading difficulty, and punctuation density
final.audit_justification: Estimates lexical heaviness, reading difficulty, and punctuation density as a mechanical texture measure, explicitly not judging whether the style is good, apt, or clear.
final.upstream_parent: surface carrier of bank criterion: Topical bite

final.name: Amount of material and marks the alteration is packaged in
final.audit_justification: Estimates the bulk of words, clauses, and punctuation marks wrapping an alteration, explicitly counting packaging rather than judging whether it is clever or warranted.
final.upstream_parent: surface carrier of bank criterion: Transformation ingenuity

final.name: Overall bulk and word heaviness of the entry
final.audit_justification: Estimates overall length and average word length as a size/bulk measure, explicitly not judging whether that bulk is warranted or funny.
final.upstream_parent: surface carrier of bank criterion: Comic payload focus

final.name: Alteration opens a new apt implication beyond substitution
final.audit_justification: Judges whether the alteration produces a fresh, apt implication beyond a plain substitution, a genuine measure of comic ingenuity, explicitly disclaiming length or punctuation as a proxy.

final.name: Vocabulary and references pin the entry to a datable moment
final.audit_justification: Measures how tightly vocabulary and references date the entry to a specific period, a temporal tell the rubric explicitly says is neither credited nor penalised as quality.
final.upstream_parent: Which contest in the long run of contests this item belongs to (the container's calendar position)

final.name: Density of punctuation and typographic marks per unit text
final.audit_justification: Estimates density of punctuation, typographic marks, and capitalisation-based emphasis relative to length, explicitly not judging correctness, necessity, or elegance.
final.upstream_parent: surface carrier of bank criterion: Linguistic polish
